name: Note
text: The overall feeling this shoot/piece should evoke — words and reference images both. Tone drives every other decision below.

name: Note
text: Direction, hardness, and color of light in your references. Note time-of-day for natural light, or lighting-setup diagrams for studio work.

name: Note
text: Framing, rule-of-thirds vs. centered, negative space usage — pieces whose composition you want to study or emulate, not necessarily their subject.

name: Note
text: A locked palette pulled from your references, so grading/color choices stay consistent across a whole series or shoot.

name: Note
text: Specific items, textures, or set-dressing pieces needed — with sourcing notes (own it, rent it, build it).

name: Note
text: Planned shots for the session: subject, angle, lens choice, and the specific reference each shot is chasing.

name: Note
text: Drop mood photos, lighting diagrams, and location scout shots (image or video cards) here — the composition notes to the left only mean something next to the actual references they’re describing.
